# 3D POLE Modeler

> Interactive 3D structural viewer for the human DNA Polymerase epsilon (POLE) catalytic subunit (p261, 2,286 AA, UniProt Q07864). Browser-based, built with Three.js and Mol*, combining a procedural schematic viewer, real-coordinate PDB viewer, variant analysis, and frameshift mutation visualization. Apache 2.0 licensed.

The project provides four interconnected viewers for exploring POLE domain architecture, catalytic mechanisms, and cancer-associated mutations:

- **Schematic Viewer** (`index.html`): Procedural cartoon-ribbon model with 8 functional domains, two-metal-ion active sites (polymerase: D640/D642 Motif A, D860 Motif C — provisional; exonuclease: D275/E277 ExoI, D462 ExoIII — verified), DNA duplex, PCNA sliding clamp, [4Fe-4S] cluster, Zn-finger motifs, and 10 mutation hotspot markers. Interactive controls for toggles, color schemes (Default/PyMOL/Accessible), keyboard shortcuts, and distance measurement.
- **Mol* Coordinate Viewer** (`molstar.html`): Real atomic coordinates from PDB 9F6D/9F6E/9F6F (Roske & Yeeles 2024, matched DNA open/ajar/closed), 9F6I-9F6L (proofreading intermediates), and 9B8S (He et al. 2024). Supports cartoon/ball-and-stick/spacefill/surface representations with domain, B-factor, chain-id, and secondary-structure coloring. Note: 9F6I/9F6J use an exo-dead construct (D275A/E277A).
- **Variant Analysis** (`variant.html`): ACMG classification with auditable Bayesian evidence codes (Tavtigian et al. 2018 LR framework, applied per Mur et al. 2023), mutational signature attribution (SBS10a/b/28/14, COSMIC v3.4), computational predictors (AlphaMissense, REVEL, CADD — REVEL used as calibrated PP3 evidence; AM/CADD shown as correlated annotations), and DDG stability estimates for 10 characterized pathogenic variants: P286R, V411L, S297F, L424V, F367S, D287E, M444K, S459F, P436R, A456P.
- **Mutation Viewer** (`mutation.html`): Side-by-side wild-type vs. truncated visualization of the c.138del germline frameshift (p.Leu46Phefs*8) with reading frame analysis, domain retention chart, and hypothesis panel (H1-H5).

Key technologies: Three.js (WebGL), Mol* (molecular viewer), ES modules, Vitest, ESLint, Julia pipeline for data processing.

## Scientific Notes

- **Exonuclease active site**: DEDDy family. Metal-coordinating catalytic residues: D275, E277 (ExoI, verified), D462 (ExoIII, verified from PDB 9F6L). D368 (ExoII) is structural/DNA-binding — NOT a metal-coordinating catalytic residue.
- **Polymerase active site**: D640/D642 (Motif A), D860 (Motif C) — human numbering provisional, not yet verified against 9F6D coordinates. He et al. 2024 (PDB 9B8S) report D626/V627/D862 as an alternative; not reconciled in this tool.
- **PP3 evidence**: Only REVEL is used as calibrated evidence for PP3/BP4 likelihood ratios. AlphaMissense and CADD are correlated annotations shown in a separate predictors panel, not stacked for LR calculation.
- **Bayesian framework**: Posterior probabilities use the Tavtigian et al. 2018 likelihood-ratio framework with gene-specific priors from Mur et al. 2023.
- **Canonical data** (`data/pole_canonical_data.json`) contains 18 total variant records (10 in the interactive viewer + 8 additional in the JSON catalogue including c.138del).

## Core JS Modules

- [pole-viewer.js](js/pole-viewer.js): Main 3D schematic viewer engine (~1,750 lines); POLEViewer class with ribbon rendering, domain architecture, active sites, DNA, PCNA, mutation markers, controls, and render loop
- [molstar-viewer.js](js/molstar-viewer.js): Mol* wrapper class; PDB loading, MVS-based domain coloring, representation switching, label projection, and zoom control
- [mutation-viewer.js](js/mutation-viewer.js): Frameshift mutation viewer; side-by-side wild-type/mutant rendering, domain retention chart, reading frame visualization
- [ribbon.js](js/ribbon.js): Geometry primitives for cartoon ribbon (helix tubes, strand arrows, loop tubes, secondary-structure segmentation)
- [pole-geometry.js](js/pole-geometry.js): Pure utility functions for procedural backbone generation (PRNG, domain backbone, inter-domain linkers)
- [pole-palette.js](js/pole-palette.js): Shared THREE.Color palette and color scheme definitions (Default, PyMOL, Accessible)
- [shared-ui.js](js/shared-ui.js): Shared UI utilities (progress bar, mobile sidebar toggle, provenance footer) used by all HTML pages

## Data Layer

- [domainConfig.js](js/data/domainConfig.js): Legacy domain definitions (DEPRECATED — migrate to poleData.js). Still consumed by pole-palette.js and molstar-viewer.js for backward compatibility.
- [poleData.js](js/data/poleData.js): Async loader and accessor for canonical JSON; schema validation, reference resolution, provenance footer
- [Canonical Data JSON](data/pole_canonical_data.json): Single source of truth for domain boundaries, active site residues, metal sites, ClinVar-anchored variants, signatures, and references
- [Data Schema](data/pole_canonical_data.schema.json): JSON Schema for validating canonical data

## Pages

- [Schematic Viewer](index.html): Main procedural ribbon viewer
- [Mol* Coordinate Viewer](molstar.html): PDB coordinate viewer
- [Variant Analysis](variant.html): ACMG classification and signature analysis
- [Mutation Viewer](mutation.html): c.138del frameshift visualization
- [AlphaFold Viewer](alphafold.html): AlphaFold predicted structure (full-length 2,286 AA with pLDDT confidence coloring)
